name: Hilltop
about: A sunny afternoon on a green hill, for a mascot platformer: cream sticker plates with a thick cocoa outline and a hard drop shadow, round letters, tomato red for what matters, grass green for what is going well, coin gold for what is won. A show of stages: a sunburst on warm yellow behind the title, dots behind a full page, confetti on a result, and nothing behind a menu laid over play, so a pause leaves the level in sight. Screens open and close on an iris, as a platformer's do.
author: mojulo
